articles.title: OpenClaw・PicoClaw・NanoClaw・Hermes：境界から比較する
articles.editorial_mode: Full-body Japanese reconstruction; synthetic scenarios and author evaluation proposals explicitly distinguished.
claims: Architecture dimensions differ; NanoClaw session separation within a group is not confidentiality separation.
NanoClaw outbound internet is open by default; hardening is separate.

articles.title: Agent Brain：モデルと実行基盤を分けて選ぶ
articles.editorial_mode: Full-body Japanese reconstruction; synthetic scenarios and author evaluation proposals explicitly distinguished.
claims: Agent Brain is editorial terminology for model selection, not a product.
Models, providers, channels, tool dispatch and policy have separate responsibilities.

articles.title: OpenClaw：チャット入口と実行基盤を一つの Gateway でつなぐ
articles.editorial_mode: Full-body Japanese reconstruction; synthetic scenarios and author evaluation proposals explicitly distinguished.
claims: Gateway is a control plane; local state does not imply prompts/chat remain offline.

articles.title: PicoClaw：小さなランタイムの価値を、条件付きで測る
articles.editorial_mode: Full-body Japanese reconstruction; synthetic scenarios and author evaluation proposals explicitly distinguished.
claims: README security and production warning preserved; marketing resource claims are not independent tests.
Security configuration maps structured fields, not invented ref strings.

articles.title: NanoClaw：コンテナ、配送、共有単位を切り分ける
articles.editorial_mode: Full-body Japanese reconstruction; synthetic scenarios and author evaluation proposals explicitly distinguished.
claims: Current namespace nanocoai/nanoclaw verified by redirect.
Host routing, per-session Docker, SQLite mailbox, group-scoped sharing and separate egress controls.

articles.title: Hermes Agent：学習をスキルと記憶へ変える運用設計
articles.editorial_mode: Full-body Japanese reconstruction; synthetic scenarios and author evaluation proposals explicitly distinguished.
claims: Skills and bounded curated memory are reusable documents/state, not success certification.
One Hermes home per agent process; profiles and backend boundaries must be inspected.
Approval modes and unattended execution settings are distinct; deny matching is not OS containment.

articles.title: OpenClaw を理解する：自律性より先に、状態と権限を設計する
articles.editorial_mode: Full-body Japanese reconstruction; synthetic scenarios and author evaluation proposals explicitly distinguished.
claims: Gateway, jobs, memories and trust boundaries must be separated.
Proposed workflow statuses are editorial, not product API states.

articles.title: OpenClaw 学習ガイド：最短の導入より、説明できる運用へ
articles.editorial_mode: Full-body Japanese reconstruction; synthetic scenarios and author evaluation proposals explicitly distinguished.
claims: Current official runtime requirement Node 24.16+ or 26.1+, Node 26 recommended.
Sandbox off by default; Gateway remains on host.

articles.title: OpenClaw アーキテクチャ：Gateway と実行の流れを追う
articles.editorial_mode: Full-body Japanese reconstruction; synthetic scenarios and author evaluation proposals explicitly distinguished.
claims: Gateway client/node distinction; accepted run and final completion differ.
Sandbox tool execution and Gateway hosting are distinct; scheduler is not model memory.

articles.title: OpenClaw の安全境界：入口・道具・実行・記憶を別々に守る
articles.editorial_mode: Full-body Japanese reconstruction; synthetic scenarios and author evaluation proposals explicitly distinguished.
claims: One trusted-operator boundary per Gateway, not adversarial multi-tenant isolation.
Tool policy, sandbox and elevated have different effects; exec can write despite file-tool denial.
Memory forget/admission are bounded controls, not blanket erasure.

articles.title: OpenClaw セットアップ：変更を理解してから段階的に接続する
articles.editorial_mode: Full-body Japanese reconstruction; synthetic scenarios and author evaluation proposals explicitly distinguished.
claims: Node requirement updated; Quick start can perform real provider completion and persist configuration.
Foreground trial and service registration have different effects.

articles.title: Control UI と運用観測：画面の状態を、完成の証拠へつなぐ

claims: Mission Control not presented as a verified standalone official product or invented mission.yaml API.
Control UI uses Gateway WS; cached state/accepted state does not prove completion.
Automations current name; cron alias.
